name: Greek Yogurt Berry Bowl
prep_steps: Spoon Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Top with mixed berries.
Sprinkle with chopped nuts and ground flaxseed.
Add a drizzle of honey if desired.

name: Overnight Oats with Chia Seeds
ingredients: 1/4 cup plain yogurt or additional milk
prep_steps: Combine oats, milk, yogurt, and chia seeds in a jar or container.
Stir well, cover, and refrigerate overnight (or at least 4 hours).
In the morning, top with sliced banana and almond butter.
Enjoy cold or microwave for 1-2 minutes if you prefer warm oats.

name: Protein Smoothie Bowl
ingredients: 1 scoop vanilla or unflavored protein powder
Toppings: granola, sliced almonds, coconut flakes
prep_steps: Blend protein powder, frozen berries, banana, and milk until thick and smooth (use less liquid for a thicker consistency).
Pour into a bowl.
Add toppings of your choice.
Eat immediately — smoothie bowls don't keep well.

name: Veggie Egg Scramble
prep_steps: Heat olive oil or butter in a skillet over medium heat.
Sauté onion and bell pepper until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add spinach and cook until wilted, about 1 minute.
Pour in beaten eggs and gently stir until cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper.

name: Avocado Toast with Eggs
prep_steps: Toast the bread to your liking.
Mash avocado with lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Cook eggs as desired (poached, fried, or scrambled).
Spread mashed avocado on toast and top with eggs.
Sprinkle with red pepper flakes if desired.

name: Banana Oat Pancakes
ingredients: 1/3 cup rolled oats (certified gluten-free if needed)
1 teaspoon coconut oil for the pan
Toppings: berries, maple syrup, nut butter
prep_steps: Blend banana, eggs, oats, and cinnamon until smooth.
Heat a skillet over medium heat with coconut oil.
Pour small pancakes (about 3 inches across) and cook until bubbles form, about 2 minutes.
Flip and cook another 1-2 minutes until golden.
Serve with your choice of toppings.

name: Cottage Cheese and Fruit Bowl
ingredients: 1/2 cup pineapple chunks or peach slices
prep_steps: Spoon cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with fruit and pumpkin seeds.
Drizzle with honey and sprinkle with cinnamon if desired.
